title: Non-Hermiticity induced thermal entanglement phase transition
summary: Theoretical analysis of a prototypical two-qubit effective non-Hermitian system characterized by asymmetric Heisenberg $XY$ interactions in the absence of external magnetic fields demonstrates that maximal bipartite entanglement and quantum phase transitions can be induced exclusively through non-Hermiticity. At thermal equilibrium as $T\rightarrow 0$, the system attains maximal entanglement ${C}=1$ for values of the non-Hermiticity parameter greater than a critical value $γ>γ_c=J\sqrt{(1-δ^2)}$, where $J$ denotes the exchange interaction and $δ$ represents the anisotropy of the system;…
